to.contextual_rationale: In ISL, prepositional directionality is inflected directly into the vector trajectory of directional verbs (e.g., GO, BRING, SEND) rather than signed as a standalone manual token. Infinitive 'to' has no manual counterpart in natural sign syntax.

up.contextual_rationale: When used in phrasal verbs ('warm up', 'stand up'), 'up' is incorporated into the unitary sign motion. When indicating vertical elevation ('hands up'), signed with deictic spatial elevation.

about.contextual_rationale: When introducing a topic ('talk about X'), topic is fronted in ISL SOV syntax (X TALK). When indicating numeric approximation ('about ten'), expressed via oscillating claw handshape.
